text:
Alejandra M: Heads up — Steering needs a concise pack for the partner health reset next Wed. Can we align on scorecard refresh + funding reallocation by EOD Fri?
Mohit S: Ack. Do we have the latest scorecard sheet? I think some SI deals weren't reflected.
Samir P: I updated pipeline last night — but the partner ACV numbers still need verification from sales.
Katie L: tagging @Mohit S — can you pull last 6mo ARR by partner? I can run the new tier thresholds once we have that.
Mohit S: Yep, pulling now. Will drop a CSV in the drive link: https://drive.redwood/p/partner-health (sheet -> 'raw_acv_export.csv')
Emily R: Quick note on funding — finance flagged a 12% headroom reduction for this quarter. We should prioritize top-of-funnel partner credits vs. co-marketing.
Derek C: Can we consider a short-lived pilot: shift 30% of unspent co-marketing into quick-burn marketplace credits for SI enablement? Would move deals faster.
Alejandra M: Sounds reasonable. Proposal: reweight scorecard to favor pipeline momentum (+10 pts) and reduce vanity metrics (-5 pts). Draft snippet below for comment:
```
Scorecard (proposed delta):
- Pipeline velocity: 30 -> 40
- Closed ACV last 90d: 25 -> 20
- New validated leads: 20 -> 18
- Enablement health (training + certs): 10 -> 12
- Strategic alignment (go-to-market plays): 15 -> 10
```
Samir P: Love the momentum tilt. One ask — make sure the SI enablement metric has a short rubric so it's not subjective.
Katie L: I'll add a 3-point rubric for enablement: 1=0-1 enablement events, 2=2-4, 3=5+. Also add a checkbox for 'joint pipeline playbook present'.
Mohit S: CSV uploaded. FYI: two partners have large deals in legal review; exclude them from this quarter's scoring but flag for next tier bump.
Emily R: On funding math — if we reassign 30% of co-marketing to credits, available slot reduces by $45k. We can cover high-impact SIs only. I'll model scenarios in the sheet.
Alejandra M: Action items: (1) Katie to add rubric + update scorecard template (2) Mohit to confirm ACV exceptions list (3) Emily to run funding scenarios (4) Samir to sanity-check pipeline velocity numbers. Please update by Thu EOD.
partnerships-bot: Reminder set: 'Partner health reset sync' added to calendar for 2026-05-04 10:00 PT (organizer: Alejandra M).
Derek C: Can we do 30min pre-read? If everyone drops final numbers by Thu EOD I can pull a 2-slide summary for executive steer.
Alejandra M: Yes — drop final updates in the sheet and add any short notes in the 'assumptions' column. I'll compile slides Fri morning. Thanks all :thumbsup:
